<?php

use React\EventLoop\Factory;
use React\Socket\Server;
use React\Socket\ConnectionInterface;

class ChatMessage {
    public string $username;
    public string $content;
    public float $timestamp;
    
    public function __construct(string $username, string $content) {
        $this->username = $username;
        $this->content = $content;
        $this->timestamp = microtime(true);
    }
}

class MessageFormatter {
    private array $templates = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->templates = [
            'join' => '[%s] *** %s has joined the chat ***',
            'leave' => '[%s] *** %s has left the chat ***',
            'message' => '[%s] <%s> %s',
            'system' => '[%s] SYSTEM: %s',
            'whisper' => '[%s] *%s whispers* %s',
        ];
    }
    
    public function getTemplate(string $type): string {
        return $this->templates[$type] ?? $this->templates['message'];
    }
    
    public function formatTimestamp(): string {
        return date('H:i:s');
    }
    
    public function renderMessage(string $type, array $args): string {
        $template = $this->getTemplate($type);
        $timestamp = $this->formatTimestamp();
        array_unshift($args, $timestamp);
        return $this->applyTemplate($template, $args);
    }
    
    public function applyTemplate(string $template, array $args): string {
        return sprintf($template, ...$args);
    }
}

class RateLimiter {
    private array $buckets = [];
    private int $maxTokens = 5;
    private float $refillRate = 1.0;
    
    public function consume(string $clientId): bool {
        $now = microtime(true);
        if (!isset($this->buckets[$clientId])) {
            $this->buckets[$clientId] = ['tokens' => $this->maxTokens, 'last' => $now];
        }
        $bucket = &$this->buckets[$clientId];
        $elapsed = $now - $bucket['last'];
        $bucket['tokens'] = min($this->maxTokens, $bucket['tokens'] + $elapsed * $this->refillRate);
        $bucket['last'] = $now;
        if ($bucket['tokens'] >= 1) {
            $bucket['tokens'] -= 1;
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
}

class AsyncChatServer {
    private array $clients = [];
    private MessageFormatter $formatter;
    private RateLimiter $limiter;
    private array $messageLog = [];
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->formatter = new MessageFormatter();
        $this->limiter = new RateLimiter();
    }
    
    public function handleConnection(ConnectionInterface $conn): void {
        $clientId = spl_object_hash($conn);
        $this->clients[$clientId] = ['conn' => $conn, 'username' => null, 'authenticated' => false];
        $conn->write("Welcome! Please enter your username: ");
        
        $conn->on('data', function($data) use ($conn, $clientId) {
            $this->processInput($clientId, trim($data));
        });
        
        $conn->on('close', function() use ($clientId) {
            $this->handleDisconnect($clientId);
        });
    }
    
    private function processInput(string $clientId, string $input): void {
        if (!isset($this->clients[$clientId])) return;
        
        $client = &$this->clients[$clientId];
        
        if ($client['username'] === null) {
            $this->handleRegistration($clientId, $input);
            return;
        }
        
        if (!$this->limiter->consume($clientId)) {
            $client['conn']->write("Rate limited. Please slow down.\n");
            return;
        }
        
        if (str_starts_with($input, '/')) {
            $this->handleCommand($clientId, $input);
        } else {
            $this->broadcastMessage($clientId, $input);
        }
    }
    
    private function handleRegistration(string $clientId, string $username): void {
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_]/', '', $username);
        if (strlen($sanitized) < 2 || strlen($sanitized) > 20) {
            $this->clients[$clientId]['conn']->write("Invalid username. Use 2-20 alphanumeric chars.\n");
            return;
        }
        $this->clients[$clientId]['username'] = $sanitized;
        $this->clients[$clientId]['authenticated'] = true;
        $joinMsg = $this->formatter->renderMessage('join', [$sanitized]);
        $this->broadcast($joinMsg . "\n", $clientId);
    }
    
    private function handleCommand(string $clientId, string $input): void {
        $parts = explode(' ', $input, 3);
        $command = strtolower($parts[0]);
        
        switch ($command) {
            case '/whisper':
            case '/w':
                if (count($parts) < 3) {
                    $this->clients[$clientId]['conn']->write("Usage: /whisper <user> <message>\n");
                    return;
                }
                $this->handleWhisper($clientId, $parts[1], $parts[2]);
                break;
            case '/status':
                $this->sendStatus($clientId, $parts[1] ?? '');
                break;
            case '/list':
                $this->listUsers($clientId);
                break;
            default:
                $this->clients[$clientId]['conn']->write("Unknown command.\n");
        }
    }
    
    private function handleWhisper(string $fromId, string $targetName, string $message): void {
        $targetId = $this->findClientByUsername($targetName);
        if ($targetId === null) {
            $this->clients[$fromId]['conn']->write("User not found.\n");
            return;
        }
        $fromUser = $this->clients[$fromId]['username'];
        $whisperMsg = $this->formatter->renderMessage('whisper', [$fromUser, $message]);
        $this->clients[$targetId]['conn']->write($whisperMsg . "\n");
    }
    
    private function sendStatus(string $clientId, string $statusMessage): void {
        $username = $this->clients[$clientId]['username'];
        $timestamp = $this->formatter->formatTimestamp();
        $formatted = sprintf('[%s] %s sets status: %s', $timestamp, $username, '%s');
        $formatted = sprintf($formatted, $statusMessage);
        $this->broadcast($formatted . "\n");
    }
    
    private function broadcastMessage(string $clientId, string $content): void {
        $username = $this->clients[$clientId]['username'];
        $msg = new ChatMessage($username, $content);
        $this->messageLog[] = $msg;
        $formatted = $this->formatter->renderMessage('message', [$username, $content]);
        $this->broadcast($formatted . "\n", $clientId);
    }
    
    private function broadcast(string $message, ?string $excludeId = null): void {
        foreach ($this->clients as $id => $client) {
            if ($id === $excludeId) continue;
            if ($client['authenticated']) {
                $client['conn']->write($message);
            }
        }
    }
    
    private function handleDisconnect(string $clientId): void {
        if (isset($this->clients[$clientId]) && $this->clients[$clientId]['username']) {
            $username = $this->clients[$clientId]['username'];
            $leaveMsg = $this->formatter->renderMessage('leave', [$username]);
            unset($this->clients[$clientId]);
            $this->broadcast($leaveMsg . "\n");
        } else {
            unset($this->clients[$clientId]);
        }
    }
    
    private function findClientByUsername(string $username): ?string {
        foreach ($this->clients as $id => $client) {
            if ($client['username'] === $username) return $id;
        }
        return null;
    }
    
    private function listUsers(string $clientId): void {
        $users = array_filter(array_column($this->clients, 'username'));
        $this->clients[$clientId]['conn']->write("Online: " . implode(', ', $users) . "\n");
    }
}

$loop = Factory::create();
$server = new Server('0.0.0.0:8080', $loop);
$chat = new AsyncChatServer();

$server->on('connection', function(ConnectionInterface $conn) use ($chat) {
    $chat->handleConnection($conn);
});

echo "Chat server running on port 8080\n";
$loop->run();
